name: Sea Sydney Harbour
summary: Private catamaran charters and small-group ticketed cruises on Sydney Harbour, run on a fleet of six vessels that carry 20 to 60 guests. Ticketed trips include sunset and daytime cruises, a dog-friendly cruise, Vivid Sydney cruises and New Year's Eve cruises. Private hire suits birthdays, corporate events, weddings, hen's and buck's parties and harbour transfers.
standouts: Fleet of six catamarans, all in survey for commercial operations
Private charters available 365 days of the year, including public holidays
Dogs on Deck, a harbour cruise that welcomes dogs on board
Awards listed by the operator include Outstanding Tourism Services 2026 (City Suburbs Local Business Awards)

trips.title: Sunset & Sparkle Harbour Cruise
trips.summary: A one hour evening cruise on Sydney Harbour aboard Kirralee, a 10.5 metre catamaran, leaving from Man O War Steps next to the Sydney Opera House. Guests have a grazing platter and a soft drink or water, and can bring their own alcohol with no corkage fee. It runs from September to May and does not run in June, July and August.

Bring your own alcohol, no corkage fees

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Private hire of a catamaran on Sydney Harbour for birthdays, hen's and buck's parties, corporate events, Christmas parties, weddings and other occasions. There are six vessels carrying 20 to 60 guests, and charters generally run 3 to 4 hours on any day of the year, including public holidays. Guests can bring their own food and drinks or add catering and drinks packages, and most boarding is at a central wharf such as King Street Wharf.

checkNotes: No whale watching trip appears anywhere on the site; the only mention is a line about migrating whales in a seasonal blog post. The operator sells private harbour charters and ticketed harbour cruises only. Three trips are left out because their pages say they are not currently running: Twilight Treasures Sunset Harbour Cruise (Rezdy product 692638), Catamaran, Champagne & Cheeseboards (online booking 'coming soon') and Valentine's Day Sunset Romance Cruise (Rezdy product 542534). The ticketed tours page and the menu also link to Rezdy catalogs for Sunset Harbour Cruises (144566), Dogs & Day Trips (587787), Harbour Romance Cruises (342695), Vivid Sydney Cruises (136438), New Year's Eve Cruises (156941) and Gift Vouchers (172193); these are catalog pages, not individual trips, so they are not entered as trip booking links. The Book Now button goes to the Rezdy storefront (seasydneyharbour.rezdy.com). Rezdy pages were not opened. On every ticketed trip page the headline 'price from' is the lowest passenger type (usually the child price, or the dog ticket on Dogs on Deck), so priceFrom uses the adult price instead; passenger maximums also differ between sections of several pages (see each trip). Phone: the first call link in the menu is +61452188793, while the visible text and every other link say +61 452 188 739; the visible number is used. The only address is a PO Box in Pyrmont; trips leave from several wharves (Man O War Steps, Aquarium Wharf, Pier 2 Walsh Bay, Pyrmont, King Street Wharf). Vivid Sydney dates shown are for 2027 (28 May to 19 June 2027). The home page lists several business awards; their issuers and standing were not checked, so only one is mentioned in standouts. The Kirralee page describes the vessel as a 'Seawind Resort 1050' of 10.5 metres. Departure times for the monthly-varying sunset cruises are in each trip's season field rather than departureTimes. About 40 pages were read (38 site pages, the blog index and the YouTube channel page the site links to); no bot check was met. Occasion pages other than birthdays (hen's, buck's, corporate, Christmas, New Year's Eve, weddings, family and social) and the awards, testimonials and contact pages were not read. Left out the home page banners (banner34a, banner32, banner30a): marketing graphics with text and borders printed on them.
